name: Davenport Village
summary: Davenport Village is a community shopping center located along North Capital of Texas Highway in northwest Austin, owned by Whitestone REIT. The center serves the surrounding affluent neighborhoods with a convenient mix of retail, dining, and service tenants.
demographics: Davenport Village serves the affluent northwest Austin market along the Capital of Texas Highway corridor, attracting upper-middle-class professionals and families with household incomes typically exceeding $100,000. The trade area draws from nearby residential neighborhoods including Jester Estates, River Place, and Steiner Ranch, with shoppers primarily aged 30-55 who value convenience and quality. The center caters to busy professionals seeking everyday services and dining options in a well-maintained, accessible location along one of Austin's primary commercial corridors.
description: Davenport Village is a well-established community shopping center strategically located at 3801 North Capital of Texas Highway in northwest Austin, Texas. Owned and managed by Whitestone REIT, a publicly-traded real estate investment trust specializing in community-centered retail properties, this center serves as a convenient neighborhood destination for the surrounding affluent residential areas. The property benefits from its prime location along Highway 360, one of Austin's most traveled corridors, providing excellent visibility and accessibility to a strong demographic base. With operating hours from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM daily, Davenport Village offers a mix of retail, dining, and service tenants that cater to the everyday needs of local residents and professionals. The center maintains a strong reputation in the community, reflected in its 4.4-star rating from over 300 Google reviews, and continues to serve as a valued neighborhood gathering place in one of Austin's most desirable areas.
